aboutUs.title: About
aboutUs.youthAboutText: Create youth activities – from a library of ready-made activities to personalized ones generated with AI. Perfect for guides looking to enrich educational and social engagement.

aboutUs.practiceAboutText: A knowledge challenge powered by AI. Choose any topic you like, and the system will generate a personalized quiz in seconds. Perfect for anyone looking for a simple and focused way to deepen their knowledge.
aboutUs.wordsAboutText: Vocabulary training made smart and efficient. Enter words or choose a topic to get a personalized practice that helps you learn, remember, and understand better – in any language.

privacyPolicy.title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

questions.q: What is ActivityWiz for youth movements?
questions.a: ActivityWiz is a smart platform for creating personalized activities for instructors and educators. You can access ready-made activities or generate new ones using artificial intelligence.

questions.q: Is the site free to use?
questions.a: Yes, using the site is free and open to everyone.

questions.q: Who is the site for?
questions.a: Anyone who leads groups: youth movement leaders, teachers, educators, parents, teen counselors, army commanders, and more.

questions.q: Can I save and edit the activities I created for later use?
questions.a: Yes. After logging in, you can save any activity you've created and update it anytime through your personal user area.

questions.q: Which languages are supported?
questions.a: The system supports English, Spanish, Hebrew, and Arabic. More languages will be added in the future.

questions.q: I need an activity for tomorrow and have no time—any quick solution?
questions.a: Absolutely. On ActivityWiz, you can generate a complete activity at the click of a button—just enter the goal, age, and duration, and you'll get a full plan for immediate use.

questions.q: What is ActivityWiz for creating event activities and games?
questions.a: ActivityWiz is a smart platform that allows you to create personalized activities and games—for any event, group, or gathering—at the click of a button, using AI.

questions.q: Is the service free?
questions.a: Yes, using the site is free and open to everyone.

questions.q: What types of events is it suitable for?
questions.a: For any social or family event—birthdays, parties, team-building, group activities, and more.

questions.q: Can I share the activity with friends or participants?
questions.a: Absolutely. Every activity can be shared with a click—via a link or by copying the text.

questions.q: What languages can be used on the site?
questions.a: The system supports Hebrew, English, Arabic, and Spanish. More languages will be added in the future.

questions.q: What is ActivityWiz for practice?
questions.a: ActivityWiz for practice is a tool that helps you practice topics smartly. You enter a topic that interests you, and the system creates a quiz with multiple-choice questions, so you can test your knowledge and learn easily and fun.

questions.q: Is the site free to use?
questions.a: No, using the site is free and open to everyone.

questions.q: Who is the site for?
questions.a: The site is suitable for anyone who wants to practice different topics, learn independently, or simply enjoy smart and fun trivia—children, teens, and adults.

questions.q: Which languages are supported?
questions.a: The system supports English, Spanish, Hebrew, and Arabic. More languages will be added in the future.

questions.q: Can I practice the same topic again with different questions?
questions.a: Absolutely

questions.q: What is ActivityWiz for vocabulary?
questions.a: ActivityWiz for vocabulary is an AI-powered tool for learning and expanding your vocabulary in any language. Simply choose a topic that interests you—and the system will create a personalized practice with multiple-choice questions, including translation, pronunciation, and audio, helping you learn quickly and effectively.

questions.q: Is the site free to use?
questions.a: No, using the site is free and open to everyone.

questions.q: Who is the site for?
questions.a: The site is suitable for anyone who wants to learn vocabulary in any language—children, teens, and adults.

questions.q: Which languages are supported?
questions.a: The system interface supports English, Spanish, Hebrew, and Arabic. However, vocabulary translations are available for any existing language.
